UVic website & personal web hosting temporarily unavailable
Last updated: 1:10 p.m. PT
A global cybersecurity issue has been discovered that is affecting systems world-wide, including the UVic website (www.uvic.ca) and personal web hosting (web.uvic.ca).
To protect university systems and information, University Systems has temporarily taken these services offline while we work to address the issue. We do not yet know when services will be restored because we are waiting for a security update from system vendors.
Off campus
If you are off-campus, uvic.ca will not be available. Sign-in to some online services may be impacted.
On campus
If you are on campus, you will be able to access uvic.ca and sign in to online tools.
We know this disruption will have a significant impact on our community. We are working to restore services as quickly and safely as possible. Thank you for your patience.
We will share more information as it becomes available.
